naslov: Clippers face the Heat on 6-game slide
tekst:
Miami Heat (2-5, 10th in the Eastern Conference) vs. Los Angeles Clippers (1-6, 13th in the Western Conference)
              Inglewood, California; Wednesday, 10:30 p.m. EST
              BOTTOM LINE: Los Angeles aims to break its six-game skid when the Clippers play Miami.
              Los Angeles went 42-40 overall with a 23-18 record at home during the 2025-26 season. The Clippers averaged 18.5 points off of turnovers, 13.2 second-chance points and 36.3 bench points last season.
              Miami went 43-39 overall with a 17-24 record on the road last season. The Heat gave up 118.5 points per game while committing 18.9 fouls last season.
              INJURIES: Clippers: Yanic Konan Niederhauser: out (lisfranc), Derrick Jones Jr.: out (knee), Jordan Miller: out (shoulder), Rui Hachimura: out (quad), Brandon Ingram: out (heel), Bradley Beal: out (knee).
              Heat: None listed.
